cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've put your bag on your head; I'll carry your book bag that way too. No trouble, though the corners are rather firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's a cushion. Let me take the books; those dictionaries are heavy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, cushioning. I'll use my folded coat underneath. You keep your hands free for the tickets.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The train's moved across the bridge. There's a low doorway on the way.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lead on, please. I'll take the books down for the doorway and carry them in my arms. A little holiday for my neck.

heightening.evidence: A5 responds to B4 height limit by moving discomfort to arms.

specificity.evidence: A1 books and tickets suggest station; B head cushion remains unmotivated.
